class.name: JRPGWaitCommand
class.brief_description: Event command: waits a while before the next command.
class.description: Waits [member steps] simulation steps (1/60 s each) before the event's next command, as [method JRPGInterpreter.wait_steps] does. Authority: server.

members.member: How many simulation steps to wait, 1 to [constant MAX_STEPS].

constants.constant: The longest wait, in simulation steps.
